description_en: Measure your prior knowledge before building the final project.

content.data:
Cara kerja sistem:
• DHT11 membaca suhu.
• Suhu mencapai batas atas → kipas ON lewat relay.
• Suhu turun melewati batas bawah → kipas OFF.
• OLED menampilkan suhu dan status kipas.

Penggunaan dua batas (histeresis) mencegah relay menyala-mati terus-menerus di sekitar satu nilai suhu.
content.data_en:
How the system works:
• The DHT11 reads the temperature.
• Temperature reaches the upper limit → fan ON via the relay.
• Temperature drops past the lower limit → fan OFF.
• The OLED displays the temperature and fan status.

Using two thresholds (hysteresis) prevents the relay from switching on and off continuously around a single temperature value.

content.data:
Alat dan bahan:
• Arduino Uno
• DHT11
• OLED I2C 128×64
• Modul relay 5 V
• Kipas DC kecil dengan catu terpisah
• Breadboard dan kabel jumper
content.data_en:
Tools and materials:
• Arduino Uno
• DHT11
• 128×64 I2C OLED
• 5 V relay module
• Small DC fan with a separate power supply
• Breadboard and jumper wires

title: Rangkaian Lengkap
description: Sambungan sisi kontrol dan sisi beban.

content.data:
Sisi kontrol (Arduino, 5 V):
• DHT11: VCC → 5V, DATA → D2, GND → GND
• OLED: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, SDA → A4, SCL → A5
• Modul relay: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, IN → D7 (active LOW)
content.data_en:
Control side (Arduino, 5 V):
• DHT11: VCC → 5V, DATA → D2, GND → GND
• OLED: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, SDA → A4, SCL → A5
• Relay module: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, IN → D7 (active LOW)

content.data:
Sisi beban (catu kipas terpisah):
• Catu kipas (+) → terminal COM relay
• Terminal NO relay → kipas (+)
• Kipas (−) → catu kipas (−), langsung tanpa relay

Relay memisahkan kedua sisi: sisi beban tidak terhubung ke Arduino sama sekali. Gunakan terminal NO (normally open) agar kipas mati saat relay tidak aktif atau Arduino kehilangan daya.
content.data_en:
Load side (separate fan power supply):
• Fan supply (+) → relay COM terminal
• Relay NO terminal → fan (+)
• Fan (−) → fan supply (−), directly without the relay

The relay isolates the two sides: the load side is not connected to the Arduino at all. Use the NO (normally open) terminal so the fan is off when the relay is inactive or the Arduino loses power.

title: Kode Program Kipas Otomatis
description: Sketch lengkap dengan histeresis dan tampilan OLED.

content.data:
Logika utama:
• t ≥ 30 °C → kipasNyala = true
• t ≤ 28 °C → kipasNyala = false
• Di antara 28–30 °C status tidak berubah (histeresis)
• Jika pembacaan gagal (isnan), status kipas dipertahankan dan OLED menampilkan Error
content.data_en:
Main logic:
• t ≥ 30 °C → kipasNyala = true
• t ≤ 28 °C → kipasNyala = false
• Between 28–30 °C the state does not change (hysteresis)
• If the reading fails (isnan), the fan state is kept and the OLED displays Error

description_en: A complete sketch with hysteresis and an OLED display.

title: Pengujian & Pengembangan
description: Skenario uji, analisis galat, dan ide pengembangan.

content.data:
Skenario pengujian:
1. Suhu < 28 °C → kipas OFF, OLED menampilkan suhu
2. Sensor dihangatkan ≥ 30 °C → kipas ON
3. Suhu turun ke 28–30 °C → kipas tetap ON (histeresis)
4. Suhu ≤ 28 °C → kipas OFF
5. Kabel DATA DHT11 dicabut → OLED menampilkan Error, status kipas tidak berubah
content.data_en:
Test scenarios:
1. Temperature < 28 °C → fan OFF, OLED displays the temperature
2. Sensor warmed to ≥ 30 °C → fan ON
3. Temperature falls to 28–30 °C → fan stays ON (hysteresis)
4. Temperature ≤ 28 °C → fan OFF
5. DHT11 DATA wire unplugged → OLED displays Error, fan state unchanged

content.data:
Analisis ketelitian sensor (bandingkan dengan termometer pembanding di beberapa titik suhu):
• Galat mutlak = |DHT11 − pembanding|
• Galat (%) = galat mutlak / pembanding × 100%
• Hitung rata-ratanya, bandingkan dengan akurasi pada datasheet.
• Catat juga waktu kipas menyala setelah suhu mencapai 30 °C untuk menilai kecepatan respons.
content.data_en:
Sensor accuracy analysis (compare with a reference thermometer at several temperature points):
• Absolute error = |DHT11 − reference|
• Error (%) = absolute error / reference × 100%
• Calculate the average and compare it with the accuracy in the datasheet.
• Also record the time it takes for the fan to turn on after the temperature reaches 30 °C to assess response speed.

content.data:
Ide pengembangan:
• Kendali kecepatan kipas dengan PWM dan driver motor
• Buzzer sebagai alarm suhu berlebih
• Log suhu ke kartu SD lewat SPI
content.data_en:
Development ideas:
• Fan speed control with PWM and a motor driver
• A buzzer as an over-temperature alarm
• Log temperature to an SD card via SPI

questions.question: Sistem pendingin memiliki batas atas Histeresis 32 °C dan batas bawah 27 °C. Suhu ruangan mula-mula 25 °C (kipas OFF), kemudian naik menjadi 26 °C -> 30 °C -> 33 °C, lalu turun menjadi 31 °C -> 29 °C -> 26 °C. Pada saat suhu turun mencapai 29 °C, bagaimana status kipas?

The room temperature is initially 25 °C (fan OFF), then rises to 26 °C -> 30 °C -> 33 °C, and then cools down to 31 °C -> 29 °C -> 26 °C. When the temperature cools down to 29 °C, what is the fan state?
options: Kipas OFF karena 29 °C di bawah 32 °C
Kipas tetap ON karena suhu belum turun sampai/di bawah 27 °C
Kipas berkedip ON-OFF secara bergantian
Kipas OFF karena 29 °C berada di rentang tengah
options_en: Fan is OFF because 29 °C is below 32 °C
Fan remains ON because the temperature has not dropped to/below 27 °C
Fan blinks ON-OFF alternately
Fan is OFF because 29 °C is in the middle range

options: Kipas menyala saat t >= 30.0 dan mati saat t <= 28.0.
Kipas justru mati saat t >= 30.0 dan menyala saat t <= 28.0 (logika terbalik).
Kipas menyala terus-menerus tanpa memedulikan nilai suhu.
Relay akan mengalami hubung singkat dan rusak.
options_en: The fan turns ON when t >= 30.0 and OFF when t <= 28.0.
The fan turns OFF when t >= 30.0 and ON when t <= 28.0 (inverted logic).
The fan stays ON continuously regardless of temperature.
The relay will short-circuit and be damaged.

questions.question: Dalam perancangan sistem pendingin darurat untuk beban kritis, pemrogram memilih menggunakan terminal NC (Normally Closed) relay alih-alih NO (Normally Open). Apa pertimbangan utama dari evaluasi ini?
questions.question_en: In designing an emergency cooling system for critical loads, the programmer chooses to use the relay's NC (Normally Closed) terminal instead of NO (Normally Open). What is the primary consideration behind this evaluation?
options: Terminal NC mengonsumsi arus listrik lebih sedikit dari mikrokontroler.
Jika mikrokontroler mendadak kehilangan daya/mati, kipas tetap menyala untuk mencegah overheat (fail-safe ON).
Terminal NC mereduksi kebisingan getaran mekanis saklar relay.
Terminal NC memungkinkan pengontrolan kecepatan kipas secara PWM.
options_en: The NC terminal consumes less electrical current from the microcontroller.
If the microcontroller suddenly loses power/shuts down, the fan remains ON to prevent overheating (fail-safe ON).
The NC terminal reduces mechanical vibration noise of the relay switch.
The NC terminal enables PWM fan speed control.

questions.question: Sebuah sensor DHT11 mengukur suhu ruangan sebesar 27,5 °C. Saat dikalibrasi dengan termometer standar laboratorium, suhu sebenarnya adalah 25,0 °C. Berapakah persentase galat (error %) dari pembacaan sensor DHT11 tersebut?
questions.question_en: A DHT11 sensor measures a room temperature of 27.5 °C. When calibrated with a laboratory standard thermometer, the actual temperature is 25.0 °C. What is the percentage error (% error) of the DHT11 reading?

options: Relay langsung LOW (kipas menyala) sebagai antisipasi keselamatan.
Evaluasi NaN >= 30.0 bernilai false, sehingga eksekusi masuk ke else dan relay HIGH (kipas mati).
Program mengalami crash dan mikrokontroler melakukan restart otomatis.
Pin RELAY berganti fungsi menjadi pin INPUT secara otomatis.
options_en: The relay immediately goes LOW (fan ON) for safety anticipation.
The evaluation NaN >= 30.0 evaluates to false, jumping to else and making the relay HIGH (fan OFF).
The program crashes and the microcontroller automatically restarts.
The RELAY pin automatically changes mode to an INPUT pin.

questions.question: Sistem kontrol suhu ruang server A menggunakan histeresis (ON pada 29 °C, OFF pada 25 °C), sedangkan sistem B menggunakan ambang batas tunggal (ON pada > 27 °C, OFF pada <= 27 °C). Mengapa sistem A lebih unggul untuk keandalan jangka panjang?
questions.question_en: Server room temperature control System A uses hysteresis (ON at 29 °C, OFF at 25 °C), whereas System B uses a single threshold (ON at > 27 °C, OFF at <= 27 °C). Why is System A superior for long-term reliability?
options: Sistem A menghemat penggunaan memori flash Arduino hingga 50%.
Sistem A mencegah saklar mekanis relay beralih menyala-mati secara cepat (chattering) saat suhu berosilasi kecil di sekitar 27 °C.
Sistem A mempercepat respons pembacaan sensor DHT11.
Sistem A memungkinkan pembacaan suhu tanpa menggunakan library tambahan.
options_en: System A saves up to 50% of Arduino flash memory usage.
System A prevents the mechanical relay switch from rapidly chattering on-off when temperature fluctuates slightly around 27 °C.
System A speeds up the DHT11 sensor response time.
System A allows temperature reading without using additional libraries.

questions.question: Seorang praktikan merangkai layar OLED SSD1306 I2C ke Arduino Uno (VCC->5V, GND->GND, SDA->A4, SCL->A5). Saat program dijalankan, layar tetap gelap. Mengubah parameter alamat I2C di dalam kode menjadi 0x3C.
Mengganti tegangan VCC OLED dari 5V menjadi 12V.
Menambahkan resistor 10k Ohm secara seri pada jalur GND.
options_en: Move the SDA wire to A5 and SCL to A4.
Change the I2C address parameter in the code to 0x3C.
Change the OLED VCC voltage from 5V to 12V.
Add a 10k Ohm resistor in series on the GND line.

questions.question: Saat relay active-LOW memicu kipas DC berdaya besar untuk ON, Arduino Uno mendadak mengalami reset berulang kali (brownout loop). Setelah diperiksa, relay VCC dan kipas dihubungkan langsung ke pin 5V Arduino. Mengapa hal ini terjadi?

options: Sinyal active-LOW merusak pin digital Arduino.
Kipas DC dan koil relay menarik arus terlalu besar dari regulator Arduino 5V, menyebabkan tegangan anjlok (voltage drop).
OLED I2C bertabrakan alamat dengan pin relay.
Sensor DHT11 mengeluarkan tegangan tinggi yang memicu reset.
options_en: The active-LOW signal damages the Arduino digital pins.
The DC fan and relay coil draw excessive current from the Arduino 5V regulator, causing a voltage drop.
The I2C OLED collides in address with the relay pin.
The DHT11 sensor outputs high voltage that triggers a reset.

options: Fungsi display.display(); tidak dipanggil untuk mentransfer buffer memori ke layar OLED.

float t_cal = dht.readTemperature() * 2.0;
float t_cal = dht.readTemperature() / 2.0;
